english_lines: He who labours for the village, di,
Knows not a single wrong, di,
Gets kicked and dies, di—buffalo calf.
notes: The colloquial `டி` force is retained as `di`, following the repository's established translation precedent for the later anthology witness.

english_lines: There is no time for what is good,
Everything that happens is outward show,
Say it plainly—it is a shame—buffalo calf.
The fellow who lives by jeering,
Struts and beats out his swagger;
But the man who contradicts his word
notes: This booklet's verified `ஏச்சிப்பொழைக்கிறவன்` differs from the later anthology witness; it is translated from this booklet only and is not repaired from the anthology.

english_lines: He talks until we believe him to be the leader of the land,
Then scoops away all the wealth he wants, di;
Thinking the country should prosper, the poor man labours all day,
For the poor there is no good time; all sorts of fellows are thriving—
notes: The verified joined form `வேணசெல்வம்` is rendered contextually without asserting a Tamil emendation.
The political-social contrast is kept pointed rather than generalized.
